newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barges quoted at mixed levels on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barges quoted at mixed levels on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at mixed levels in bids and offers on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded versus no barges traded on Friday.
- Two barges, this week, Illinois River, bid 150 percent, down 2-1/2 percentage points, no offer.
- Two barges, next week, Illinois River, no bid, offer 160 percent.
- Two barges, next week, St Louis, no bid, offer 120 percent.
- 10 barges, two each week December, Illinois River, bid 152-1/2 percent, up five percentage points from Friday bid, offer 165 percent.
- 10 barges, two each week December, St Louis, Mississippi, bid 100 percent, unchanged from Friday, similar, no offer.
